cards.method_and_execution: I worked on proposals and sales collateral, account coordination, and a more structured way to reuse prior knowledge in the proposal workflow.
cards.artifacts: Proposals, credentials, client briefs, knowledge-management assets, and trackers.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned that business development works better when delivery evidence is easy to retrieve and the proposed work remains specific to the client.

cards.title: Next-generation battery technology screening
reach_out_when: You need to compare emerging battery technologies
You need a structured R&D investment screen
cards.trigger: A trading-company R&D team needed to identify battery technologies with potential commercial relevance.
cards.problem: Promising technologies differed in maturity, cost, use case, demand, and competition, so one performance measure could not rank them fairly.
cards.method_and_execution: I helped assess technology options against practical application and commercial criteria and structured a prioritisation view for further investigation.
cards.artifacts: Technology landscape, evaluation criteria, prioritisation matrix, and research deck.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned to make maturity and commercialisation assumptions explicit when comparing technologies at different stages.

cards.title: Millennial co-branding strategy for a legacy automotive brand
reach_out_when: You need to select a co-brand partner
You need to turn a partnership concept into an activation plan
cards.trigger: A legacy automotive brand wanted to build relevance with younger customers.
cards.problem: A partner needed both audience overlap and brand fit, followed by a practical plan for activations and measurement.
cards.method_and_execution: I assessed potential partner brands, helped frame the fit criteria, and developed a roadmap for commercial and marketing collaboration.
cards.artifacts: Partner shortlist, brand-fit analysis, activation roadmap, and evaluation framework.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned that co-branding needs a credible connection between audiences and a clear operating plan after the announcement.

cards.title: Luxury automotive sales-service SOP design
reach_out_when: You need a consistent high-touch dealership experience
You need to translate customer expectations into operating steps
cards.trigger: A luxury automotive brand needed a consistent approach to the customer journey.
cards.problem: The process had to cover the full relationship from lead handling through post-sale engagement while allowing for premium service expectations.
cards.method_and_execution: I researched customer expectations and helped design sales-process standard operating procedures for a luxury automotive customer journey.
cards.artifacts: Customer study, journey map, sales SOP, and implementation guidance.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned that a service standard is useful when its actions are observable and supported by frontline teams.

cards.title: Two-wheeler captive-finance business planning
reach_out_when: You need to assess captive finance for an automotive OEM
You need to link finance product design to customer and dealer needs
cards.trigger: A two-wheeler manufacturer examined whether a captive-finance business could improve customer access and commercial performance.
cards.problem: The concept required a viable customer segment, product terms, partner structure, and operating capabilities.
cards.method_and_execution: I contributed to feasibility, customer and competitor analysis, product and operating-model questions, and staged business planning.
cards.artifacts: Feasibility reports, customer research, business-model options, and implementation plans.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned that finance strategy needs careful alignment between customer value, risk, dealer operations, and collection capabilities.

cards.title: Strategic supplier and procurement benchmarking
reach_out_when: You need to compare suppliers beyond quoted price
You need to structure a strategic sourcing decision
cards.trigger: An industrial client considered a more coordinated battery procurement strategy.
cards.problem: Supplier selection needed to weigh supply capability, terms, delivery performance, and strategic fit.
cards.method_and_execution: I assessed supplier and competitor information and helped frame a sourcing plan with criteria for selecting and negotiating with vendors.
cards.artifacts: Supplier assessment, benchmark, sourcing options, and proposal material.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned that a procurement recommendation is stronger when it shows trade-offs and assumptions behind the shortlist.

cards.title: Sunscreen market-entry channel strategy
reach_out_when: You need to choose channels for a consumer-product launch
You need to match customer segments with distribution partners
cards.trigger: A Japanese personal-care company explored launching sunscreen in India.
cards.problem: The route to market had to fit distinct customer groups, buying habits, and channel economics.
cards.method_and_execution: I researched consumers, benchmarked competitors, assessed distribution options, and developed a market-entry channel strategy and partner view.
cards.artifacts: Consumer segments, channel map, competitor analysis, and market-entry recommendations.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned to start channel design from customer behaviour rather than assume one national route to market.

cards.title: US skincare brand repositioning
reach_out_when: You need to reposition a skincare brand
You need to connect category evidence with a differentiated offer
cards.trigger: A Japanese skincare group assessed its positioning in the United States.
cards.problem: The work needed to understand category trends, channels, competitors, and customer reasons to choose or reject the brand.
cards.method_and_execution: I contributed to market and competitor research and helped turn category and customer evidence into positioning and product questions.
cards.artifacts: Category landscape, competitor maps, SWOT, product benchmarking, and recommendations.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned to test brand differentiation against both customer language and the way alternatives are sold in the market.

cards.title: ASEAN cosmetics market-entry prioritisation
reach_out_when: You need to choose among ASEAN entry markets
You need to adapt a beauty offer to different countries
cards.trigger: A diversified Japanese beauty group explored expansion in Southeast Asia.
cards.problem: Country choices needed to reflect market growth, category trends, consumer preferences, and the feasibility of a regional operating approach.
cards.method_and_execution: I researched macro and cosmetics-category trends, compared priority countries, and shaped a regional go-to-market plan.
cards.artifacts: Country screens, market model, consumer synthesis, and go-to-market recommendations.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned that a regional strategy needs common criteria while preserving country-level differences.

cards.title: Automotive cost-optimisation programme
reach_out_when: You need to find cost opportunities across an automotive value chain
You need to turn a benchmark into an action programme
cards.trigger: An automotive business wanted to identify structural cost improvements.
cards.problem: A credible programme required comparison across functions and prioritisation of initiatives that could be executed.
cards.method_and_execution: I benchmarked the automotive value chain, identified performance gaps, and helped plan a multi-part cost-improvement programme.
cards.artifacts: Benchmark, opportunity map, and cost-improvement roadmap.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned that a benchmark becomes useful when it identifies owners, timing, and operational constraints for each lever.

cards.title: Automotive demand forecasting and supply-chain optimisation
reach_out_when: You need a more granular vehicle-demand forecast
You need to link forecasting to inventory decisions
cards.trigger: An automotive manufacturer needed a better basis for supply and inventory planning.
cards.problem: Demand varied by geography and product attributes, making a broad forecast insufficient for operational decisions.
cards.method_and_execution: I combined bottom-up and top-down demand forecasts, using regional and product-level cuts, and applied a continuous-improvement approach to supply and inventory planning.
cards.artifacts: Forecast model, planning cuts, inventory recommendations, and review cadence.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned to make forecast assumptions visible and connect model updates to the decisions they are meant to improve.

cards.title: Second-life EV battery reuse and recycling strategy
reach_out_when: You need to assess second-life battery uses
You need to compare reuse and recycling partner options
cards.trigger: An automotive client considered how batteries could generate value after their first vehicle life.
cards.problem: Reuse use cases, technical requirements, policy, and recycling pathways had to be assessed together.
cards.method_and_execution: I helped screen possible second-life applications, review customer and policy requirements, and assess potential recycling partners.
cards.artifacts: Reuse opportunity map, policy analysis, partner shortlist, and research materials.
cards.impact_or_learning: I learned to separate the value of a reuse use case from the practical requirements for safe deployment and end-of-life handling.
